snippet.title: Jurassic World Evolution 3: Rebirth Expansion | Announce Trailer
snippet.description:
A new era is born in the action-packed Jurassic World Evolution 3: Rebirth Expansion, coming 16 June!
 
Delve into a game expanding narrative inspired by the dramatic events of Jurassic World Rebirth. Take control of three top-secret locations, and come face-to-face with four new dinosaurs, including the terrifying Distortus rex!

Find out more: https://fron.dev/a156

Build your own Jurassic World. Nurture generations of dinosaurs with the series debut of juveniles, create and manage sprawling prehistoric parks around the globe, and let your imagination roar with powerful new creative options. Available now on PC, PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S

#JurassicWorldEvolution3 #HelpLifeFindAWay #FrontierDevelopments #Xbox #PlayStation #PCGaming #Games #Gaming
